description: Since ancient times, the magical inhabitants of the seas have been under the protection of fairies who use the mystical Dance of the Wind to scare away evil. Over the years, magic began to fade, and magical creatures began to disappear. Now, the last of its kind in China can only be saved by a young fairy named Lin, who must find someone to share the Wind Dance with and hide a unique creature from poachers.
